feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate (entity0) is the iteration 7 build (kd 0.8, kp 3.5, base_speed 1.6, sensors y 0.07 at x -0.04 to +0.04, sensor_size 0.012, line_loss last_direction) with one change: controller.kd 0.8 to 1.0. Geometry, kp, base_speed, line_loss and sensor_weights are unchanged, so the race isolates derivative damping. The evidence so far: kd 0.3 to 0.5 (iterations 3 to 4) cut oval steering_oscillation from 0.19 to 0.11 and gave about +1.5 points, and kd 0.5 to 0.8 (iterations 4 to 7) moved the score from 64.17 to 304.77, with 13 of 20 oval finishes. Iteration 8 showed that kp 3.0 at kd 0.8 scored 296.66, below iteration 7, so kp is not the lever to push. The risk is that the derivative is amplifying sensor noise. At kd 0.8, steering_oscillation rose to 0.32 on the oval and 0.23 and 0.25 on the s-bend and slalom, which are the tracks still failing. Going to kd 1.0 extends that trend, so a rise in oscillation is plausible. Nothing here predicts this candidate's result. Interpret the race as follows. If the score is at or above 304.77 and the s-bend or slalom progress rises above 0.30 and 0.19, keep kd 1.0 and consider a base_speed reduction next. If the score falls below 304.77 or oval finishes drop below 13 of 20, revert to kd 0.8, which is the best raced design. If the bends still fail with steering_oscillation at or above 0.25, the derivative is past its useful range and the next lever is base_speed, not gain. Approve now: this is the only remaining action-run budget for a clean derivative test and there are two iterations left, so the race telemetry is worth more than another revision round.
requested_changes: If the score is below 304.77 or oval finishes fall below 13 of 20: revert controller.kd to 0.8 with kp 3.5, since iteration 7 is the best raced design and kd above 0.8 increased oscillation (oval 0.11 to 0.32 across kd 0.5 to 0.8).

If the score is at or above 304.77 but s-bend or slalom progress stays at or below 0.30 and 0.19 with steering_oscillation above about 0.25: keep kd near 1.0 and lower controller.base_speed from 1.6 toward 1.4, since the bends are overshooting and iteration 8 showed kp reduction alone did not clear them.

If the robot stays on track on all three tracks but misses the 3.0 s limit: raise controller.base_speed from 1.6 toward 2.0 with the chosen kd, since the oval mean finish of 1.90 s shows speed is not the limit there and the bends are the constraint.
